_comment: Persona library. Copy the ones you want into config.json under "personas", set target/cap, reorder by priority. A person is assigned to the FIRST persona they match, so order is the tie-break. Every match field is optional; all listed fields must pass. Values: a list (membership), a string (single value), {"min": n} / {"max": n} for numbers, {"any": true} for non-empty, {"not": [...]} for exclusion, "title_match" for a regex over the verified title and self-reported role.

library.name: Community operator
library.why: Runs a meetup, chapter, cohort, or devrel program. The cross-promotion engine of the room, and the reason influence is weighted at 40.

library.name: Amplifier
library.why: Owns a real audience. Anything they post about the event reaches people you cannot.

library.name: Verified founder
library.why: Self-declared founder whose company survived the founder check with funding or real revenue.

library.name: Early-stage founder
library.why: Founding something real but early or unconfirmed. Kept separate so the room is not all seed-stage.

library.name: Senior enterprise
library.why: Director and above inside a large company. Usually the scarcest persona, so expect the quota to spill.

library.name: Name-brand operator
library.why: Works somewhere the room recognizes. Logos in the room, without needing seniority.

library.name: Technical builder
library.why: Ships with the tool already. These are the people who unblock a table, so table seeding depends on having enough of them.

library.name: Investor
library.why: Capital in the room. High leverage for founders, and a different conversation than operators.

library.name: Operator
library.why: Runs a function inside a company. Manager through VP, not founding, not enterprise-senior. The default working majority of most rooms.

library.name: Domain specialist
library.why: Sits in a focus vertical. Use when the event is pitched at an industry rather than a job type.

library.name: Academic or educator
library.why: Teaches or researches. Brings a cohort behind them, which is distribution of a different shape.

library.name: Press or creator
library.why: Writes about this for a living. Decide deliberately whether the room is on record.

library.name: Emerging talent
library.why: Students and early career. Cheap to seat, and the reason a room does not calcify. Usually needs a floor AND a cap.

library.name: Practitioner
library.why: Catch-all. Matches everyone left. Always put it last, and leave its target null so it absorbs the spill.
